component.name: KwikLook
component.summary: Quick previews of files from Dolphin

description.p: Select a file in Dolphin and press Space to see a quick preview of it, without opening another app.
Song covers and AppImage icons, a lighter background viewer, and crash reports.

ul.li: Song covers and AppImage icons show, using the same thumbnails as Dolphin.
The background viewer gives back the memory of the last preview a few seconds after it closes, and no longer quits by itself.
If KwikLook crashes, KDE's crash dialog offers a report for the project's issue page.

description.p: Books, and the next file ready before you get there.

ul.li: EPUB books show their cover, title and author, then the chapters as text with the book's table of contents.
The files next to the one you're looking at are prepared in the background, so going to the next picture is instant.
Camera RAW photos show as pictures; Share offers LocalSend when it's installed.
Fixes for web pages and books with tables, Markdown files that start with a logo, and the PDF sidebar's tabs.

description.p: The preview opens where you want it, and pictures give it their shape.

ul.li: A new setting chooses where the preview opens: centred on the screen, on the Dolphin window, or at the mouse pointer.
Pictures give the window their shape and fill it edge to edge; vector pictures fill the window and stay sharp.
Where you are among the files shows for a moment in the bottom-right corner, together with the zoom level.
The up and down arrow keys switch files too; AppImages can be installed with AppImage Manager.
Contact and calendar libraries are optional; fixes for a crash after code files and for pictures on scaled screens.

description.p: A visual review, and editing handed to other apps.

ul.li: The contents sidebar shows headings as a tree that folds in and out.
Going to the next file no longer flashes an empty page; it fades over once the file is ready.
Code blocks and quotes stand out in Markdown and HTML; PDFs show the page number while you scroll.
Songs show their cover large on a blurred backdrop; videos that don't start by themselves show their first picture.
Cropping pictures and trimming videos moved out of the preview: “Open with…” offers Spectacle's editor and your video editor.

description.p: Contents in the sidebar, archives listed, and a quieter background viewer.

ul.li: PDFs, office documents, Markdown and HTML files list their headings in the sidebar; the section you're reading is marked and a click goes there.
Archives (zip, 7z, tar, RAR, ISO and more) show what's inside as folders, with sizes and dates, without unpacking anything.
The viewer no longer uses the processor in the background after an animated picture or a PDF.

description.p: Find in text and PDFs, formatted views, fonts, tables and cards, and small edits to pictures and videos.

ul.li: Markdown, HTML, JSON, SVG and .desktop files show formatted, with a button for their source; CSV files as a table, contacts and calendar events as cards.
Fonts show a sample and can be installed; PDFs get a page overview; an index sheet shows all files at once.
Pictures can be cropped and turned, videos trimmed and turned, always keeping the original or moving it to the Trash.
Videos and audio get volume, repeat and full screen; the bar's buttons can be chosen in the settings.
With several files selected in Dolphin, the preview goes through just those.

description.p: Office documents (through LibreOffice, sandboxed), video and audio, and zoom for pictures, text and PDFs.

ul.li: Animated pictures play.
Enter opens the file in its usual application; the bar shows the position, like “2 / 5”.
Long text files no longer freeze the preview; several smaller fixes.

description.p: The first release: press Space in Dolphin to preview pictures, text and code, PDFs and the details of any file.
